page.overview:
What is Deka Deka no Mi?

The Deka Deka no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that drastically enlarges the user's body, making them a . It was eaten by Sanjuan Wolf.

The Deka Deka no Mi's ability is to greatly increase the user's body size. It is unknown how tall the ability could make a human, but when wielded by the giant Sanjuan Wolf, it allows him to increase his height to maximum of roughly ten times an ordinary giant's height, making him the largest individual in the world. It seems the gigantification of the eater is permanent upon consumption of the fruit, as the current user, Wolf, did not revert to his original size even when submerged under the sea.

Due to the user's increased size, it can be difficult for them to be rescued or helped should they happen to find themself in a particular dangerous situation. They might also cause unintended damage due to their size, particularly in cramped areas. Apart from this, the user suffers from the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Sanjuan Wolf, who was a giant from start, has used this ability to become the largest person in the world, with a maximum height of 180 m (590'6"). Despite being weak against water, he is tall enough to stand in certain parts of the ocean, though he did mention that doing so was exhausting to him. With his immense size, he can easily pick up buildings and reorganize them with ease, which he did so when Hachinosu's layout was altered by Kujaku's ability.
